messages:
Elena (content): Idea: launch a lightweight OSS refapp called 'EdgePlay' — focused on edge/low-latency patterns. We need a launch post, a concise benchmark narrative, a 20-min demo webinar, and clear inbound routing. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Samir (growth): Love the angle. Keeps it distinct from Benchlab. Recommend 3-week runway + gated webinar. Replay gating experiment recommended.
Devon (devrel): I'll own the repo + quickstart. Aim for a 1-command Docker run and a tiny benchmark script. Example snippet for landing:
```
docker run --rm -p8080:8080 redwood/edgeplay:0.2.0
curl -sS -X POST localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"What is KV cache?"}'
```
Kara (design): I'll mock a compact hero gif showing request->response and a small chart for the benchmark highlight. Need headline candidates.
Elena (content): Headline A: "EdgePlay: inference patterns for low-latency apps" Headline B: "Run an edge refapp, measure latency, optimize" Which is punchier?
Samir (growth): A is distinct and aligns with audience. For routing: HubSpot list = edgeplay_launch_2024. Form fields = email, company, deployment_interest. Add qualifier: "Need SLA/enterprise? (Y/N)" to signal SDRs.
Rafael (analytics): UTMs: utm_source=edgeplay, utm_campaign=edgeplay_q3. Hidden fields: original_source and deployment_interest. Track events: quickstart_success and bench_report_submit. I'll make a dashboard for p50/p95 metrics we publish.
Devon (devrel): For the benchmark narrative I'll compare default vs quantized model configs and show p95 tail improvement and tokens/sec. Will include CSV and a tiny script to reproduce.
Kara (design): CTAs: "Try EdgePlay" (GitHub) and "Register demo" (webinar). I'll prepare two hero variants for A/B testing.
Elena (content): Deliverables: launch blog (me), benchmark mini-case (Devon+Rafael), webinar page (Samir), README & quickstart (Devon), slides (Devon+Elena), visual assets (Kara).
Samir (growth): Promotion plan: dev community seeding, targeted X posts, small LinkedIn spend for enterprise lists for 5 days. Also ask partners to cross-post. Replay gated but test 50/50 open vs gated for reach vs leads.
announce-bot: calendar_event: 'EdgePlay: low-latency refapp demo' scheduled for 2024-07-25T16:00:00Z
Rafael (analytics): Also suggest tracking 'first_benchmark_metric' when users run the quickstart and submit a result to a minimal collection endpoint — helps measure activation.
Devon (devrel): I'll add a Colab notebook as an alternative to Docker and a tiny gif demo for the landing. Repo PR by Wed.
Kara (design): I'll upload hero comps and social tiles to Figma by Tue EOD. Need final micro-copy from Elena.
Elena (content): I'll draft two short intros for the blog (technical + product angle) and a short social copy that leads with a metric hook once Rafael gives numbers.
Samir (growth): I'll set up the HubSpot list and registration page this week; will add utm defaults and Zap to send calendar invites.
Rafael (analytics): I'll share the tracking doc and dashboard link before the staging launch.
Elena (content): Timeline: briefs by Tue, drafts Wed, PRs Thu, staging landing Fri. Check-in Friday 11am PT. Keep social copy very metric-driven and developer-focused. :thumbsup:
